<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Chainsaw" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Customer order with chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Update" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback on first chainsaw"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw Producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" name="Send order properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Update" name="Send production update" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Send feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw Production" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts are ordered in parallel from various online sources.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Production_Split" name="Start production">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <!-- Branch A: parts and assembly -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PartsArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts manually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSaw" name="Assemble chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Branch B: regular production updates -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Update_Merge" name="Update due">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Running</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send production update to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Running" name="Production still running?" default="Flow_Done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Running</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Synchronization of both production branches -->
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Production_Join" name="Production complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Feedback" name="Receive customer feedback">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Liked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce rest of the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Liked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Gateway_Running"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Running" sourceRef="Gateway_Running" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${productionRunning}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Done" sourceRef="Gateway_Running" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Join" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Liked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerLikesSaw}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="EndEvent_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FirstSaw" name="First chainsaw delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Customer feedback on first chainsaw"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw Producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" name="Send order properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Update" name="Send production update" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Send feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Chainsaw Production" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordSpecs" name="Record chainsaw specifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Production_Split" name="Start production">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from online sources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrived" name="Parts arrived">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts manually">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleSaw" name="Assemble chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Update_Merge" name="Update due">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Running</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send production update to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Running" name="Production still running?" default="Flow_Done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Running</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Production_Join" name="Production complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_FirstSaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Feedback" name="Receive customer feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Liked" name="Customer likes the saw?" default="Flow_NotLiked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Liked</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce rest of the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Liked</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotLiked" name="Rest of order not produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotLiked</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_RecordSpecs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordSpecs" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrived" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSaw" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Update_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Gateway_Running"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Running" sourceRef="Gateway_Running" targetRef="Gateway_Update_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${productionRunning}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Done" sourceRef="Gateway_Running" targetRef="Gateway_Production_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Production_Join" targetRef="SendTask_FirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="SendTask_FirstSaw" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Feedback" targetRef="Gateway_Liked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerLikesSaw}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" sourceRef="Gateway_Liked" targetRef="EndEvent_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that after an enabling step, several activities of the same kind are to be started in parallel (for example ordering items from various sources), and each activity is named as a separate action: Model each separately described parallel activity as its own task (for example a bpmn:serviceTask when it is an automated call to an external source) placed between the parallel fork and the parallel join that follows the enabling step. Do not omit these activities or merge them into a single task or a bare sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description says that after an enabling step, several activities of the same kind are to be started in parallel (for example ordering items from various sources), and each activity is named as a separate action

rules.instruction: When the description states that items are ordered from outside sources in parallel and their later arrival is described as a separate event that must happen before a manual step can follow: Model the ordering of the items as its own task on a branch leaving the parallel split, separate from the event that the items arrive. Model the arrival as a distinct intermediate catch event that is waited for before the step that uses the items, and do not merge the ordering and the arrival into one element or omit the ordering task.
rules.situation: the description states that items are ordered from outside sources in parallel and their later arrival is described as a separate event that must happen before a manual step can follow

rules.instruction: When the description states that the organization's work on an order can start only after the customer has communicated the requirements, and that the organization then starts several activities in parallel: Model the organization's own step of establishing or recording the customer's requirements as a separate task performed by the organization, placed before the parallel split that starts the parallel activities. Do not omit this task just because the description mentions only the customer's communication and the parallel activities.
rules.situation: the description states that the organization's work on an order can start only after the customer has communicated the requirements, and that the organization then starts several activities in parallel

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an action that is a step of the process, such as communicating an outcome to another party or collecting feedback from a party, and that action happens on only one branch of a decision or after the main work is done: Model each such performed action as a task, placed on every branch where the description states it occurs and in the order the description gives. Do not replace the performed action with an intermediate throw or catch event. Reserve intermediate events for occurrences the process waits for or reacts to.
rules.situation: the description states that the process itself performs an action directly toward an outside party (for example handing over a finished item, or a partial delivery) and then continues the sequence based on that party's reaction

rules.instruction: When the description lists several actions that a participant performs in sequence, and some of them come before a parallel split, after a decision, or on a branch that ends the process: Model each stated action as its own task (userTask, manualTask, or serviceTask according to who performs it), placed in the order the description gives and connected by sequence flows. Do not drop a stated action, and do not stand in for it with a start, catch, or end event. A wait for an external occurrence stays an intermediate catch event, but the stated work that checks or handles that occurrence is still a task.
rules.situation: the description lists several actions that a participant performs in sequence, and some of them come before a parallel split, after a decision, or on a branch that ends the process

rules.instruction: When the description states that a party supplies the required specifications or attributes of the item to be built, and that obtaining the components or parts starts only after those attributes are known, for example as a parallel fan-out: Model the act of recording those specifications as a human activity placed before the parallel split that starts component procurement, so the split is reached only after the specifications are known. Use a user task when the person captures the specifications in software, and a verb-object label taken from the description's wording. Do not leave this step implicit or move it into the procurement branches.
rules.situation: the description states that a party supplies the required specifications or attributes of the item to be built, and that obtaining the components or parts starts only after those attributes are known, for example as a parallel fan-out

promoted.trigger: the description says that after a preceding step, several activities of the same kind are to be started in parallel, and each activity is named as a separate action
promoted.instruction: Model each separately described parallel activity as its own task (a bpmn:serviceTask when it is an automated request to a system) placed between the parallel fork and the parallel join that follows the preceding step. Do not omit these activities or merge them into a single task or a bare sequence flow.
